summary.zh: 与纳卡达同期发掘的前王朝墓地；Petrie & Quibell《Naqada and Ballas》报告 ERA 工作。不与晚期（新王国）Deir el-Ballas 宫殿遗址混为一谈——本条仅登记报告中的前王朝墓地语境。
summary.en: Predynastic cemeteries excavated with Naqada; Petrie & Quibell Naqada and Ballas reports ERA work. Do not conflate with later (New Kingdom) Deir el-Ballas palace settlement — this record covers the Predynastic cemetery contexts as published.
